'''John That's it the rebels are there! hoth deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[John]]
* '''Published:''' 1 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-L-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 ECC John LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck that I have made has taken me weeks of revising and editing, though it has never failed me against my friends I still know that it cn be better so please tell me what I can do to make it better.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

All good imperial decks have the death star in them. With this deck I can blow up the death star and make the imperials come into hoth. they will face frostbite and ice storm  and have to ome into mydocking bay so then I can kill them off .
